rule: Only the following system exports may be recommended. A standalone house/property export is not supported and must never be suggested.
house_data_fallbacks: Use queryRptData for official monthly counts where supported.
Use listHouseByCondition/getHouseByHouseNo for current listing snapshots.
Clearly separate historical monthly statistics from current listing snapshots.
If a required historical house field is unavailable, explain the limitation in plain Chinese and recommend a product/API enhancement; do not recommend a house export.
